text: Three cargo vessels are struck by projectiles in or near the Strait of Hormuz, including one vessel 11 nautical miles north of Oman that catches fire and evacuates crew. Additional damage reports occur near the UAE coast. Maritime authorities issue transit warnings as vessel movement through the waterway remains minimal.

meta.note: Shipping disruption overlaps with military activity; classification chosen for trade-flow constraint rather than battlefield action.

text: U.S. consumer price index rises 0.3% month over month and 2.4% year over year in February, matching consensus forecasts. Core CPI records 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annual increases. Shelter and services prices increase modestly while several goods categories decline, leaving the annual inflation rate unchanged from January.

meta.note: Energy shock mentioned in reporting occurs outside the CPI observation window and is excluded from classification.

text: The International Energy Agency approves a coordinated release of 400 million barrels from member emergency oil stockpiles. The reserves will be distributed across member states over an unspecified timeframe. The action occurs while tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely halted and global oil markets exhibit elevated volatility.

meta.note: Energy supply intervention could also fit macro-economy; financial infrastructure chosen due to coordinated reserve mechanism.

text: The United States announces the release of 172 million barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve with delivers beginning the following week and extending over approximately 120 days. The action occurs alongside a coordinated International Energy Agency reserve release during disrupted global oil supply conditions.

meta.note: Overlap with earlier IEA reserve action; logged separately due to distinct national reserve mechanism.
